# immutable-state-graph

Behavior contract:
freezeGraph(value) deeply freezes an object/array graph and returns the original root. Traverse all own DATA-property values, including nonenumerable and symbol keys, without invoking getters. Handle cycles and shared references. Ignore primitives and functions. Inputs contain ordinary objects and arrays (no typed arrays, Map or Set).

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
